description: Minified source code for jQuery UI Draggable widget version 1.14.1, providing draggable functionality within the jQuery UI library.

methods.name: _create
methods.description: Initializes the draggable widget, setting position, classes, and event handlers.

methods.name: _setOption
methods.description: Updates widget options dynamically.

methods.name: _destroy
methods.description: Cleans up the widget, removing event handlers and classes.

methods.name: _mouseCapture
methods.description: Determines if a mousedown event should start a drag.

methods.name: _blockFrames
methods.description: Prevents iframe issues during dragging.

methods.name: _unblockFrames
methods.description: Removes iframe blocking elements.

methods.name: _blurActiveElement
methods.description: Removes focus from active element during drag.

methods.name: _mouseStart
methods.description: Begins the dragging operation, setting initial positions.

methods.name: _refreshOffsets
methods.description: Calculates offsets for dragging calculations.

methods.name: _mouseDrag
methods.description: Handles the dragging movement.

methods.name: _mouseStop
methods.description: Ends the dragging operation, handling revert and cleanup.

methods.name: _mouseUp
methods.description: Handles mouse release event during drag.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Cancels the current drag operation.

methods.name: _getHandle
methods.description: Determines if the event target is a valid handle.

methods.name: _setHandleClassName
methods.description: Adds handle class for styling.

methods.name: _removeHandleClassName
methods.description: Removes handle class.

methods.name: _createHelper
methods.description: Creates the helper element for dragging.

methods.name: _setPositionRelative
methods.description: Sets position to relative if needed.

methods.name: _adjustOffsetFromHelper
methods.description: Adjusts cursor offset based on helper options.

methods.name: _isRootNode
methods.description: Checks if a node is html or body.

methods.name: _getParentOffset
methods.description: Calculates parent offset for positioning.

methods.name: _getRelativeOffset
methods.description: Calculates relative offset for positioning.

methods.name: _cacheMargins
methods.description: Caches element margins.

methods.name: _cacheHelperProportions
methods.description: Caches helper element dimensions.

methods.name: _setContainment
methods.description: Sets containment boundaries for dragging.

methods.name: _convertPositionTo
methods.description: Converts position to absolute or relative.

methods.name: _generatePosition
methods.description: Calculates the new position during dragging.

methods.name: _clear
methods.description: Clears helper and resets state after drag.

methods.name: _trigger
methods.description: Triggers widget events.

methods.name: _uiHash
methods.description: Returns UI state object.
